summary: A lambda is a small unnamed function such as s -> s + 5. Java filters and transforms collections with the Stream API: filter(), map(), collect(), and reduce().
notes: Nothing in a stream runs until a terminal step such as collect(), toList(), or reduce().
reduce(0, (acc, s) -> acc + s) starts at 0, so an empty stream returns 0.
mapToInt(Integer::intValue) turns a Stream<Integer> into an IntStream, which has sum() and max().
pitfall: Reusing a stream after a terminal step throws IllegalStateException: stream has already been operated upon or closed. Call scores.stream() again for each pipeline.
